title: Six Sigma's DMAIC
caption: Each stage depends on the one before: define the problem, measure performance, analyse for root causes, improve the process, then control it so that the gains last.
alt: Five boxes in order: define, measure, analyse, improve, control.
description: Define the problem, requirements and goals.
Analyse data to find root causes.
Improve the process to remove causes.
Control the improved process to sustain gains.

steps.label: Control
steps.note: the new process to sustain gains
